metadata.description: Resume, cover letter and job application tools for Claude, via the ResumeNext MCP servers.

plugins.name: resumenext-ats-resume-checker
plugins.description: Check a resume's ATS score, see what to fix first, and open it in the ResumeNext resume builder with templates and a live score.

plugins.name: resumenext-job-match
plugins.description: Compare a resume with a job description: matched and missing keywords, coverage, and a job-tailored ATS score.

plugins.name: resumenext-cover-letter
plugins.description: Check a cover letter against a fixed checklist, read example letters by role, and open the final letter in the ResumeNext cover letter editor.

plugins.name: resumenext-resignation-letter
plugins.description: Write a resignation letter in a standard, formal or grateful style and open it in ResumeNext to edit and save as PDF, DOCX or TXT.

plugins.name: resumenext-linkedin-resume
plugins.description: Review the text of a LinkedIn profile section by section and turn it into a resume that opens in the ResumeNext editor.

plugins.name: resumenext-resume-examples
plugins.description: Browse resume examples by role and resume templates, each with a link that opens it in the ResumeNext editor as a starting point.

plugins.name: resumenext-resume-bullet-points
plugins.description: Check resume bullet points line by line for action verbs, numbers, pronouns and phrases to delete, and get action verbs by type of work.

plugins.name: resumenext-resume-skills
plugins.description: Get the skills and terms that recur for a role and see where a resume uses them: listed and shown, listed only, shown only, or not mentioned.
